dd3b8b08b9ef241b039249c3567a4f9376c32d32.summary: A 2015 blog post describes CryptoFortress ransomware. The author began hunting for Gootkit, found a Nuclear Pack instance in France pushing CryptoFortress via CVE-2013-2551 on 2015-03-04, and first took the sample for Teerac.A (aka TorrentLocker). The sample then showed a close identity with CryptoFortress. The author says the post was heavily edited to fix a mistake. Two samples are listed, and the post cites an ESET TorrentLocker report and a CertLexsi CryptoFortress reading.

dd6d41f85b017215453613836f43314d67625dcc.summary: Index-style page from HarfangLab's Inside The Lab series with short summaries of several threat reports. Covers XDSpy's XDigo malware against Eastern European and Russian government entities since March 2025; Pterodo samples linked to Gamaredon; Ivanti CSA exploitation leading to webshells in late 2024 and early 2025; Lumma Stealer delivered via HijackLoader; the AvNeutralizer anti-EDR tool; Cyclops malware against Middle-East targets; Doppelgänger influence operations by Russian actors around the 2024 French election; a Brazil payload; and MuddyWater activity since October 2023.
